title: Incremental effect of surge-preceded insider disclosure
extraction_rule: Transcribe reported surge/non-surge means and regression beta; beta -0.0029 fractional return ×10,000 = -29 bps. Association enrichment is separately identified, never plotted on this return axis.

study_context.universe: F&O intersection formed from names ever present in archived futures panel; not PIT membership certification
study_context.observation_clock: public insider disclosure date; delivery signal known by event date
study_context.hypothesis_entry: next-session cash open; SSF execution hypothesis T+1 open
study_context.actual_ssf_comparison: settle-to-settle proxy with artificial narrow high/low solely to avoid solid-bar rejection
study_context.benchmark: same-window equal-weight eligible universe in each cash/SSF path
study_context.costs: 0A gross forward-excess test; no full cost-swept executable-book return
study_context.inference: association via within-symbol permutation; prediction/interaction event-date cluster robust SE

caveats: Validated primary event set only: absolute lift floor and 32-calendar-day refractory; contaminated inline recomputation excluded.
39.9-sigma enrichment describes co-occurrence, not predictive significance.
Reported bps and t values are rounded report transcriptions.
SSF settle proxy and ever-in-F&O universe limit claims of executable or PIT SSF translation.
Post-hoc threshold and prior-return subsets are not passing candidates.
